The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with nothing left. The full suite passes offline (608 tests, build success).

- `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockTest.java`: new test `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft`, which reproduces your example. Bolt 10, nuts taken to 0, screws set to 0; the list is `["Bolt"]` and nut quantity is 0.

Nothing is committed.
